saga: Y1 Steward Sibyl the Gray: “The granary counts 40 measures — a season, no more. Plant a farm on open plains.”
Y1 Steward Sibyl the Gray: “Every wall and roof to come is standing in that forest. A lumber camp — near the trees, while they last.”
Y1 The raiders have set up camp in the wilds — Ravenmoor. For now, it is only a nest of brigands.
Y2 Steward Sibyl the Gray: “When they mass at the tents, you have time yet. When the camp stirs — you do not.”
Y2 The war-camp stirs — Ravenmoor may march soon.
Y2 Steward Sibyl the Gray: “You have swords enough to answer the warlord at the tents, sire — if you dare leave home thin.”
Y3 The war-camp stirs — Ravenmoor may march soon.
Y3 The host marches on Ravenmoor — 14 swords. The kingdom stands thinner behind them.
Y3 Steward Sibyl the Gray: “The ground there is spent, and the camp struck itself — the timbers are already home. The land lies open for the plough now. Follow the forest.”
Y4 The host falls upon Ravenmoor! Battle is joined at the tents.
Y4 The camp is stripped bare — arm-rings and weapons off the dead: 25 gold, 20 goods.
Y4 One slips through the reeds — Wren, a cook. Remember the name: Wren.
Y4 Ravenmoor is no more. 8 souls. The Chronicle will keep their names even if you will not.
Y4 13 of your soldiers come home marked by the burning. Nothing frightens them now — and they will never lay down the sword.
Y4 The host returns from the ashes of Ravenmoor. No songs are sung.
Y4 The axes fall silent at a lumber camp — the wood nearby is spent. The cleared land lies open.
Y4 The lumber camp at the spent ground is struck — its timbers come home.
